english.toefl: 79 legacy / 4 new for limited status; 103 legacy / 5 new for full status
english.note: Limited-status minima; full status IELTS 7.5 or DET 135. Below full status requires English placement and possible ESL/reduced load. Tests valid two years before entry. No Essentials, MyBest or IELTS One Skill Retake. Exemptions require a US/approved-country degree or at least two years of study/work there, each within five years of entry; foreign English medium alone does not qualify. TA speaking rules separate; DET cannot establish TA proficiency. Department regards IELTS 7.5 / legacy TOEFL 103 as better preparation, occasionally accepts lower published minimum.

applicationFee.note: Current central fee $90 for all applications, overriding older department domestic $70. Waivers limited to eligible domestic categories; international exception only valid exchange agreement with approved fee waiver.

documents: Personal statement: preparation, faculty fit and career plans
Unofficial transcripts from all postsecondary schools; official after acceptance
requirements.note: GPA 3.0; lower requires departmental petition. Broad biology, physics, chemistry, mathematics and statistics preparation; deficiencies may be remedied. Contact faculty strongly encouraged; interest important to committee decision. At least one reference familiar with US university system and one active scientist with recent close work. Spring resources/admission limited.

funding.note: All offers carry support; PhD stipend, full tuition and partial fee waiver guaranteed five years with documented annual progress. Offer specifies TA/RA/fellowship terms. International offers discussed explicitly.
